assessment_summary: I validated all three components described in the installation guide (backend, app, cms) against the claimed installation state. BACKEND: Confirmed via 'docker compose ps' that all 5 containers (postgres 14.1, keycloak 26.0, meilisearch 1.7.6, localstack, wiremock poi-test-api) are up and healthy. Confirmed the Spring Boot application MendenCmsApplicationKt is running (PID 10139, Java 25 at /opt/java25) and functionally serving requests: GET /v1/feature-collection/experiences returned 200 with valid GeoJSON, /swagger-ui/index.html returned 200, and /tmp/bootrun.log shows clean startup (Tomcat on 8080, 75 events imported from the wiremock POI API, Meilisearch indexes configured, zero ERROR lines). Meilisearch, LocalStack, and WireMock health endpoints all returned 200. The backend portion of the guide is fully satisfied and operational. FRONTS (app + cms): The guide's verification step is 'pnpm install' succeeding, then running 'pnpm nx serve/build erlebnis.stadt' (app) and 'pnpm start' (cms). I verified the install cannot complete: both workspaces' .npmrc point @sw-code to npm.pkg.github.com with no token configured (no GITHUB_TOKEN in environment, no _authToken in .npmrc, no ~/.npmrc); unauthenticated requests to npm.pkg.github.com return 401 for both metadata and tarballs, and the public npm registry returns 404 for @sw-code packages — there is no alternative source. The app lockfile references 34 and the cms lockfile 114 @sw-code package occurrences, and neither node_modules contains any @sw-code package, no top-level directory links, and no .bin (only partial .pnpm stores of 1782/1462 entries). Concretely, the documented tasks were executed and failed: 'pnpm nx show project erlebnis.stadt' exited 254 with 'Command \"nx\" not found', and 'pnpm start' in cms failed with 'nx: not found'; 'pnpm nx serve' and 'pnpm nx build' are equally impossible with nx absent. Therefore two of the three required components of the web app are not installed and cannot operate without further setup (supplying a GitHub PAT per the guide's own prerequisites and completing pnpm install). Limitations: I could not test frontend serve/build behavior end-to-end because the missing credential blocks dependency installation (I am prohibited from installing dependencies or adding credentials to repair the installation); the empty experiences FeatureCollection (0 features) appears to be normal seed data at this commit since the API and search index respond correctly. Assessment: the backend is complete and operational, but the overall installation is incomplete — the frontends cannot run without further installation work, meeting the failure definition.
